archetypes.name: bash32
archetypes.rationale: The diff adds a Bash 3.2-sensitive helper with tolerant probes, arrays, argv parsing, and exit-code preservation.
archetypes.prompt_body: Investigate the new shell helper and harness for Bash 3.2 compatibility and shell-control-flow hazards. Pay particular attention to argv parsing, array expansion, fallible command substitutions, pipelines, redirections, and whether any path can exit before the intended logging and saved return code behavior. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.

archetypes.name: oos-audit
archetypes.rationale: The change moves OOS disposition enforcement and audit logging into a new checkpoint script, which is a high-risk workflow boundary.
archetypes.prompt_body: Review whether accepted OOS findings remain durably dispositioned after the extraction from inline orchestration into the checkpoint helper. Focus on the interaction among accepted files, ndjson discovery, filed URL sources, append-tool-failure logging, site tokens, and the conditions for clearing or preserving OOS_PENDING. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.

archetypes.name: orchestrator
archetypes.rationale: The diff changes the Step 8+ orchestrator/helper boundary and must preserve ownership of state transitions and resume behavior.
archetypes.prompt_body: Assess the new division of responsibilities between SKILL.md orchestration and oos-disposition-checkpoint.sh. Verify that the helper owns only input plumbing, gate invocation, and failure logging, while the orchestrator still owns run-statistics, OOS_PENDING clearing, and pr-create re-entry semantics. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.
